assets.prompt: A production sprite atlas for an original cooperative island tower defense game, stylized hand-painted 3D isometric fantasy miniatures, elegant readable silhouettes, warm stone brass wood with teal magic. STRICT EXACT GRID 6 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, 24 separate buildings, square canvas, every grid cell same size, exactly one centered complete building inside each cell with generous transparent padding, no cell borders no text no labels no UI no ground tiles. Transparent background. Consistent 3/4 camera. Row 1 turquoise tide faction left to right: small crossbow turret; mist crystal pylon; electric arc coil; tidal mirror basin; purple rarity elaborate storm coil; legendary giant weather-control observatory with orbital turquoise crystals and lightning rods. Row2 ember red copper faction: fire arrow turret; bellows furnace; coral mortar cannon; explosive fuse beacon; elaborate volcanic kiln; legendary massive crimson coastal artillery with three barrels. Row3 mechanical brass slate faction: rapid bolt turret; rivet cannon; triple volley crossbow; precision calibration radar; mechanical assembly workshop; legendary many-barreled walking fortress on a stationary circular platform. Row4 starlight ivory violet faction: small star shard turret; guiding lantern; prismatic mirror; resonance bell; elaborate astronomy tower; legendary great constellation lighthouse with suspended golden rings. Rarity progression is clearly visible across each row, first two modest, middle two more engineered, fifth intricate, sixth spectacular. Designed to crop into 24 equal cells and render at 50 to 100 pixels. Sharp isolated object edges, NOT a poster.

Production transparent sprite atlas for an original fantasy cooperative island tower defense. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows, square canvas, equal cell sizes, one complete centered isolated creature in each cell, generous transparent gaps, no text no labels no grid borders no scenery. Consistent high-angle 3/4 stylized hand-painted 3D miniature camera, expressive distinct readable silhouettes, polished mobile game art, teal sea magic, coral orange, violet, gold. Row1 left to right: cute hostile teal slime; quick purple shore crab; armored blue hermit crab with iron shell; glowing lavender jellyfish. Row2: spiky orange pufferfish; seaweed shaman with kelp staff; huge coral stone golem regular boss; little seaweed minion. Row3: massive gold-hoarding giant crab with treasure gold shell (bounty boss); crystal-shell giant hermit carrying treasure chest guarded by crystal spikes (bounty boss); regal ancient tidal leviathan with coral crown and teal runes (legendary bounty boss); teal armored bounty guard. Row4: tiny mechanical cannon companion; golden treasure chest; glowing blue evolution crystal; mysterious ancient relic compass. Objects fill 65 to 78 percent of each tile with no clipping. Fully transparent background.

Game background texture only, original cooperative tower defense island, high-angle top down view with slight isometric painterly 3D treatment. Landscape 5:4 canvas. A single broad flat verdant island plateau filling almost entire image with thin rocky coast and rich deep teal sea around edges. Warm pale grass, small moss stones and a few tiny ferns concentrated at outer edges, teal tidal pools and weathered ancient stone platforms near coastal edges. The central 85 percent is quiet flat traversable meadow, no buildings, NO roads, no characters no text no UI no circles no pads. Clear controlled detail, soft afternoon light from upper left, premium strategy game terrain, richly painted edges but calm center that supports overlaying roads and many small tower sprites. Do not place large trees or rocks in central playable area.

Original game key art for a cooperative island tower defense game, landscape 3:2 composition, premium hand-painted fantasy 3D illustration. Four connected island outposts encircling a turquoise sea vortex. Foreground a dramatic copper many-barrel fortress and a luminous turquoise weather observatory, left crimson volcanic artillery, right a celestial ivory lighthouse with golden orbital rings. Small gold treasure crab and regal ancient coral leviathan approach on the shore surrounded by hostile teal slimes. Curving arcs of lightning and fire show defenses combining their attacks. Strong readable silhouettes and coherent scale, islands feel connected into one shared battlefield. Elegant deep navy teal palette with warm golden light, adventurous atmosphere. No text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark. Full bleed, crop-safe central composition suitable for a mobile cover thumbnail.
